title.value: R5: Rule Discovery with Reinforced and Recurrent Relational Reasoning
title.justification: The title highlights the focus of the paper on rule discovery using reinforced and recurrent relational reasoning techniques.
title.quote: R5: R ULE D ISCOVERY WITH R EINFORCED AND R E - CURRENT R ELATIONAL R EASONING

extractions.description: This paper introduces R5, a relational reasoning framework that uses reinforcement learning to discover and reason over relational graph data. R5 explicitly extracts compositional logical rules to train on small-scale tasks and generalize to large-scale tasks. The framework includes a policy value network and Monte Carlo Tree Search to perform recurrent relational prediction and rule mining, demonstrating systematicity, robustness to noisy data, and improved explainability over embedding-based models.
